text:
claire: Dropped PR #534 with the relnotes + changelog for the minor release. Main asks: 1) confirm JS + TS snippets run, 2) short migration note for model pinning behavior, 3) one public-facing known-issue about reranker latency. Please review before EOD.

henry: Looking now. JS snippet uses `new Redwood()` which is legacy; should be `new redwood.Client()` per v0.11.0. I'll paste a corrected one.

mike: Also: the docs mention the reranker latency increase only as an internal ticket. We should add a short customer-facing blurb and a recommended mitigation (reduce candidate set or switch to batched-rerank). Keep it non-technical.

henry: Fixed JS snippet minimal: ```js
import { Client } from 'redwood';
const client = new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY });
const res = await client.rerank({ input: 'q', candidates: ['a','b'] });
console.log(res.scores);
```
Ran locally, no runtime errors.

claire: Nice. For the migration note: add one short example showing model pinning JSON and a sentence: "Pinned routes may fall back to a compatible variant if the exact model snapshot is unavailable (see KB-7890)." Keep the KB short-id.

mike: For the reranker blurb: propose: "Known issue: reranking latency may increase for large candidate sets on some models; workaround: reduce candidates or enable batched reranking. We are rolling a perf fix in the next patch." Short and public-friendly.

l10n-bot: Localization check: the phrase "fall back" flagged for ambiguity in several languages. Suggest use "may automatically use a compatible model variant". Also flagged a long sentence in German file.

claire: Good catch. Update to: "Pinned routes may automatically use a compatible model variant if the exact snapshot is unavailable (see KB-7890)." Keep it concise.

henry: Ran snippet-linter: TS example had an unused import; removed it. Also fixed a trailing comma in the JSON example in the migration guide. Pushed both small fixes.

ci-bot: Running snippet-verify + linkcheck on refs/heads/release/relnotes-534.

ci-bot: snippet-verify: JS/TS examples OK. docs-lint: 1 terminology warning ("rollback window"). linkcheck: found 1 external 404 -> replaced with stable spec link by henry.

mike: I swapped the wording for rollback to "rollback plan" to avoid translation issues. Also added rollout dates (Sep 14-15 UTC) and staged canary at 4%.

claire: One more ask: add a tiny "How to smoke test" CLI command in PR comments: `redwoodctl smoke --scenario=rerank --timeout=15s` expecting `{"status":"ok"}`. That helps SRE.

henry: Added smoke test and a grep example to validate output keys.

ci-bot: Final: snippet-verify passed. linkcheck: all external links 200. docs-lint: terminology fix applied. Ready for editorial pass.

claire: Plan: merge after quick editorial pass tomorrow morning. If telemetry shows regression during canary, we'll execute rollback plan and notify customers. Leave any last edits in PR #534. Thanks all :party_parrot:
